name: manual_1bfece
claim: For Schannel private-CA tests, distinguish trust acceptance from revocation checking; best-effort revocation may permit a known test CA but must not permit mismatched or missing trust.

decisions.notes: Native curl 8.22.0 accepted the matching private CA with best-effort revocation, while default revocation returned exit 60 and mismatched or missing CA still failed.

rationale: Native curl 8.22.0 accepted the matching private CA with best-effort revocation, while default revocation returned exit 60 and mismatched or missing CA still failed.
